diff:
diff --git a/src/l2_fixture_py/text.py b/src/l2_fixture_py/text.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..4a40848
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/l2_fixture_py/text.py
@@ -0,0 +1,7 @@
+import re
+
+
+def slugify(text: str) -> str:
+    """Turn a human-written title into a URL slug."""
+    slug = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text.lower())
+    return slug.strip("-")
diff --git a/tests/test_text.py b/tests/test_text.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..a603b2b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_text.py
@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+from l2_fixture_py.text import slugify
+
+
+def test_slugify_basic() -> None:
+    assert slugify("Hello, World!") == "hello-world"
+
+
+def test_slugify_collapses_separators() -> None:
+    assert slugify("a  --  b") == "a-b"
+
+
+def test_slugify_strips_leading_trailing() -> None:
+    assert slugify("  -Hi-  ") == "hi"
